name: Abditosaurus
sum: Abditosaurus is a titanosaur from the Maastrichtian Conques Formation of Catalonia, Spain, the most complete titanosaur skeleton found in Europe.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; a partial skeleton collected from 1954 and described in 2022.
